feed.title: KeyCorp Reaffirms 2026 Outlook as Loan Growth, Margins and Fees Gain Momentum
feed.summary: KeyCorp has reaffirmed its 2026 outlook, citing strong client activity, anticipated commercial loan growth at the higher end of its 4-5% target, improved credit quality, and deposit growth exceeding 2% in the latter half of the year. The bank raised its fee-income growth outlook to 4-5% following the Clearwater acquisition and is increasingly confident in achieving a core return on tangible common equity of over 15% by 2027. Despite a changing economic backdrop with expected rate increases, KeyCorp sees continued healthy activity in both lending and fee-based businesses.

feed.title: REG - PureTech Health PLC Citigroup Inc - Holding(s) in Company

Citigroup Inc. now holds a total of 5.940610% of voting rights in PureTech Health PLC, comprising direct voting rights and rights through various financial instruments. The notification includes a detailed breakdown of these holdings and the chain of controlled undertakings.

feed.title: Costco brings back a fan-favorite food court treat after years off the menu
feed.summary: Costco has announced the limited-time return of its twisted churro to U.S. food courts, much to the delight of fans who have been requesting its comeback for two years. The announcement followed a cryptic social media tease from the company, sparking widespread speculation among shoppers. While many celebrated the churro's return at its original price of $1.49, some expressed disappointment that it was only for a limited time or that it wasn't the older, classic straight version.

feed.title: Theravance Biopharma Shareholders Endorse Merger with Zymeworks Inc.
feed.summary: Theravance Biopharma shareholders have approved the merger agreement with Zymeworks Inc. during an extraordinary general meeting on September 18, 2026. The Merger Proposal received overwhelming support, satisfying the supermajority condition required for closing. The merger is now anticipated to be completed on or about September 23, 2026, subject to the fulfillment of remaining conditions.

feed.title: Cencora (COR) Raised Guidance and Bought Back $1B. What’s the Catch?
feed.summary: Cencora (COR) reported strong fiscal third-quarter results, with revenue up 5.1% and adjusted EPS climbing 12.0%, leading to raised full-year guidance and $1 billion in stock repurchases. However, this profit growth significantly outpaced sales growth, driven by the OneOncology acquisition which also introduced higher operating expenses and debt. The article highlights a key tension: while profit margins improved due to the acquisition, the long-term sustainability is questioned by increased costs, interest expenses, and the rising volume of lower-margin GLP-1 drugs.

feed.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger helped protect 240,000 acres of California ranchland; the vast habitat is home to rare species and condors
feed.summary: Former California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger played a significant role in the landmark 2008 agreement that protected up to 240,000 acres of the 270,000-acre Tejon Ranch. This vast ranchland, located at the confluence of four ecological regions, is crucial habitat for the California condor and over 60 other at-risk plant and animal species. While Schwarzenegger publicly announced the deal, the negotiations were primarily conducted between the Tejon Ranch Company and five major environmental organizations, establishing a long-term conservation and land-use framework.

feed.title: PPL Corporation stock gains support from Morgan Stanley price target cut
feed.summary: PPL Corporation stock has received an Overweight rating from Morgan Stanley, despite a price target cut to USD 39.00, reflecting continued analyst support. The shares are trading around USD 33.41, implying a 20.7 percent upside to the consensus target of USD 40.31. While the stock offers an attractive dividend yield of 3.41 percent, risks related to interest rates, regulatory decisions, and capital expenditures are noted as factors that could impact its valuation.

feed.title: Keysight Technologies Sees AI Data-Center Boom, Targets 6G and Defense Growth
feed.summary: Keysight Technologies is experiencing strong demand from AI data-center buildouts, particularly in high-speed networking and silicon photonics, and is targeting future growth in 6G wireless, aerospace and defense, and software-defined vehicles. Despite supply constraints, the company is expanding capacity and expects to maintain high incremental margins while investing in R&D to capture these emerging opportunities.

feed.title: Bank of America Sets 12-Month S&P 500 Target at 7,800, Sees 2% Upside
feed.summary: Bank of America (BofA) has set a 12-month S&P 500 target of 7,800, representing a 2% upside from current levels, while also raising its year-end forecast to 7,400. Strategist Savita Subramanian highlighted potential market risks including inflation, Federal Reserve policy, and credit conditions, noting that half of BofA's bear market indicators have been triggered. Despite near-term concerns, BofA maintains a positive long-term outlook for equities, projecting significant earnings growth for the S&P 500 in 2026 and 2027, and favoring large-cap value stocks and equal-weighted indexes.

feed.title: Hubbell acquires Ventev for ~$73M (SEC)
feed.summary: Hubbell Incorporated acquired Alliance USAcqCo 2, Inc. (Ventev) in the first quarter of 2025 for approximately $73 million, net of cash acquired. This acquisition was sourced from Hubbell's Form 10-Q filing for the quarter ending September 30, 2025. The deal involved a carve-out of a Tessco division into Hubbell, with Ventev identified as a wireless infrastructure business.

feed.title: The Discontinued Campbell's Canned Soup Flavor That Left A Hole In Some Holiday Traditions
feed.summary: Campbell's has discontinued its cream of shrimp soup, disappointing many home cooks who relied on it for holiday recipes like shrimp dip and casserole. The soup, which reportedly disappeared from shelves in 2025, is no longer listed on the company's website. For those looking to recreate the flavor, alternatives include using Blue Runner's cream of shrimp soup, doctoring Campbell's cream of onion soup with shrimp and tomato puree, or making a scratch-made version.

feed.title: Amgen or Merck: Which Drugmaker Has the Stronger Dividend Growth Story?
feed.summary: This article compares Amgen (AMGN) and Merck (MRK) as dividend growth investments, concluding that Amgen offers a stronger dividend growth story. Amgen provides a higher current yield, more consistent and aggressive dividend raises, and a more diversified product portfolio, making its dividend more durable against future patent expirations. Merck, while having growth potential, relies heavily on its Keytruda franchise and faces challenges with its pipeline execution.

feed.title: Blutek / Ingersoll Rand — Dig ACQ to SEC 10-K final $10.3M (Oct 2024)
feed.summary: Ingersoll Rand finalized its acquisition of Blutek S.r.l. on October 1, 2024, with a reported cash consideration of $10.3 million. This figure was confirmed in Ingersoll Rand's FY2025 Form 10-K, revising the preliminary $10.5 million valuation. The acquisition details are publicly available via SEC filings.

feed.title: Truist advances AI to create more meaningful client interactions
feed.summary: Truist Financial Corp. has fully deployed AI Call Summaries across its care centers, utilizing generative AI to automatically summarize client conversations. This technology frees care center employees from note-taking and post-call documentation, allowing them to focus more on clients, resolve issues faster, and provide personalized service. The initiative has already saved over 36,000 hours in Q2 2026 and Truist plans to expand its use to other areas of the bank.

The company will also cover harvesting plans and strategies for reducing wildfire risks. The events are scheduled for September 21st in Centre 2000 and September 23rd at the Grande Cache Inn.

The company aims for cash-on-cash returns in the low 20% range and expects to significantly increase its power capacity under development. Executives emphasized a customer-centric approach, building infrastructure where demand is visible and preparing facilities for higher-density AI workloads.

feed.title: Coca-Cola accelerates US investments with $10 billion plan
feed.summary: The Coca-Cola Company and its bottling partners plan to invest $10 billion in U.S. infrastructure between 2026 and 2030, including new production, distribution, and office facilities. This investment builds on their existing network of over 70 production facilities and hundreds of distribution centers. The company also highlighted a study showing its system contributed $85 billion to the U.S. GDP in 2025, supported nearly 1 million jobs, and allocated $37 billion to U.S. suppliers.

feed.title: Carson Rowland Breaks Silence on 'Sweet Magnolias' Cancellation After Exit
feed.summary: Carson Rowland has commented on the cancellation of Netflix's "Sweet Magnolias" following his exit from the show. Netflix decided not to renew the series for a sixth season, instead ordering a new drama from the showrunner. Rowland had previously chosen not to reprise his role, with the show's creators leaving the door open for a potential return for his character.

feed.title: UnitedHealth Group stock gains on Q2 beat and raised 2026 guidance
feed.summary: UnitedHealth Group's stock closed at USD 377.06 on September 18, 2026, marking a 14.2% year-to-date increase, following strong Q2 2026 results that surpassed revenue and EPS expectations. The company also raised its full-year 2026 guidance, driven by improved operational trends and a robust cash flow, particularly in Medicare and Optum Health. Analysts have responded with upward revisions to earnings estimates and a "Strong Buy" rating, supported by the company's consistent performance and expansion in the individual coverage health reimbursement arrangement market.

feed.title: Targa Resources (TRGP) Set a Record Quarter and Then Raised the Bar
feed.summary: Targa Resources (TRGP) reported a record second quarter with Adjusted EBITDA reaching $1.60 billion, a 38% increase year-over-year, driven by strong Permian Basin natural gas and NGL volumes. The company is actively expanding its infrastructure with new plants and fractionators, funding this growth with significant borrowing, which poses both opportunities and risks depending on market conditions. Hedge fund ownership increased, suggesting growing investor confidence despite the stock being priced for continued growth.

feed.title: Why Is the Market Reassessing STMicroelectronics (STM)?
feed.summary: The market is re-evaluating STMicroelectronics (STM) as the chip rebound expands beyond AI accelerators to include embedded and power applications, highlighting the company's focus on automotive and industrial semiconductors. This shift means attention is now on STM's operational position and its ability to demonstrate progress amidst changing market conditions, rather than just broader macro trends. The company's unique position in automotive and industrial semiconductors gives it distinct opportunities and challenges that differentiate it from other technology stocks.

feed.title: DataMeds AI Litigation Settlement Extinguishes ~$19 million In Liabilities and Retires 364,099 Common Shares
feed.summary: DataMeds AI has settled litigation related to outstanding debt and receivables from its 2023 Wellgistics transaction, eliminating approximately $19 million in balance-sheet liabilities for a cash payment of $450,000. As part of the settlement, the company also retired about 364,099 common shares. This resolution allows DataMeds AI to concentrate on its core healthcare technology and AI platforms.

feed.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Stock Could Be 22% Overvalued On New York Hub Opening
feed.summary: A Simply Wall St. analysis suggests that Fortinet (FTNT) stock might be overvalued by approximately 22% based on its discounted cash flow (DCF) valuation, despite its recent strong share price performance and the opening of a new Innovation Hub in New York. The article highlights that while the new hub could support future demand, the current share price of $169.84 already prices in a significant amount of this potential. The analysis presents both bull and bear case narratives, with some seeing the stock as undervalued and others as overvalued.

feed.title: Intercontinental Exchange stock edges higher as interest-rate leverage draws analyst focus
feed.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) stock is gaining attention from analysts due to its strong ties to interest rates through its fixed-income and mortgage-technology platforms. Despite trading at a premium compared to some peers, analysts and fair-value models project a mid-to-high teens percentage upside. This outlook is supported by resilient earnings and structural demand linked to interest rates, though potential rate cuts pose a risk.

feed.title: Royal Caribbean’s (RCL) $1.25B Debt Deal Hides A Bigger Story
feed.summary: Royal Caribbean (RCL) recently completed a $1.25 billion debt offering, which appears to be routine refinancing. However, this move highlights the company's significant debt obligations maturing in 2027 and 2028, and its continuous need for capital for new ships and destination projects, despite strong booking volumes. While earnings are growing, challenges such as flat third-quarter pricing and geopolitical impacts on bookings raise questions about future profitability.

It emphasizes that while the NYSE Composite provides context, the core of NiSource's story lies in its specific operations and the need for detailed company communication to validate this attention. The distinguishing factor for NiSource is its combination of utility operations and the market's re-evaluation of financial structures.

These finds cater to various needs from home organization and seasonal decorating to yard work and DIY projects.

feed.title: Union Pacific stock gains after UBS upgrade and solid second quarter figures

feed.title: FedEx Counts on Polish Billionaire to Crack Markets in Europe
feed.summary: FedEx is relying on Polish billionaire Rafal Brzoska and his company, InPost, to expand its presence in European markets. InPost, valued at approximately $9 billion, will maintain operational independence and Brzoska will remain CEO. This acquisition provides FedEx with InPost's extensive automated parcel locker infrastructure, strengthening its competitive position against other logistics giants in Europe.

feed.title: Kansas City's midtown Costco closes Oct. 1. It'll reopen next year — with no food court or pharmacy
feed.summary: The Costco store in Midtown Kansas City is closing on October 1st and will reopen next spring as a Costco Business Center. This conversion means the store will focus on supplies for restaurants, small shops, and offices, omitting many typical Costco offerings like the food court, pharmacy, clothing, and liquor sales. Despite local opposition, the change is proceeding, driven by the company's aim to optimize sales in a location that, while successful enough to repay public tax breaks early, reportedly underperformed in general merchandise compared to its strong liquor sales.

feed.title: Dollar Tree shares key update on higher prices
